name: vital-trusted
description: Nineteen skills that help people across a life-sciences company use an AI assistant for daily work with peace of mind, against seven needs: Tangible, Rule-compliant, Unbiased, Safe, True, Ethical, Defensible. Supports, never replaces, the company's own SOPs and review. No connector and no key: the Prove skills check claims, sources and references by hand against the material the person supplies, and label every such result not tool-checked. Pilot build, not published. Human oversight required for healthcare use. Product of Crossroads Catalyst GmbH (Vital Expert).
